messages:
rachel-sales: Urgent  Acme Freight POC fails when they include full conversation + doc text in one request. They get 413 and an error "context_too_long". Demo in 4h, can we triage?

pete-eng: 413 usually byte-size. If it's >32k tokens gzip won't help. Do we have gateway log?

rachel-sales: Gateway: "413 Payload Too Large: 48MB". App: {error:"context_too_long",max_context_tokens:32768}. Customer client is locked down; can't change before demo.

nora-ps: Fast paths: 1) upload docs via /v1/uploads and reference upload_id in prompt; 2) temporary gateway bump for this account for demo; 3) lightweight proxy that ingests and summarizes then forwards. Which works?

pete-eng: Uploads is safest and quick (~20m). Proxy prototype could be ready in ~2h but needs legal ok. Temporary bump possible but needs approval and may still hit token guard.

ci-bot: uploads-service: staging deployed, feature-flag uploads_v1=true.

rachel-sales: I'll push the uploads option and offer proxy if they can't. Also ask for account id to request temp bump.

pete-eng: If they agree to uploads, provide sample curl for multipart/form-data and we'll stand by to validate. If they insist on single body, we'll open infra ticket for a short window.

rachel-sales: Thanks team, sending options to customer now. Will update once they pick.
